title: Claims Integrity & Payment Adjudication Policy: Modifier 25 with Minor Surgical Procedure
regulatory_framework: CMS Claims Processing Manual Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 § 30.6.6 / OIG Work Plan / AMA CPT Guidelines
summary: Audits claims where an Evaluation and Management (E/M) service is billed with Modifier 25 on the same date of service as a minor procedure (0 or 10-day global period). Requires documentation of a distinct, significant clinical problem beyond usual pre/post-procedure work.

criteria.name: Documentation of Significant, Separately Identifiable Medical Problem
criteria.description: Progress note must clearly substantiate evaluation/management of a clinical condition unrelated to or distinctly above and beyond the decision to perform the minor procedure.
criteria.statutory_reference: CMS Pub 100-04 Ch 12 § 30.6.6; CPT Coding Instructions

criteria.name: Independent Medical Decision Making (MDM) or Time Substantiated
criteria.description: The separate problem's history, exam, and cognitive medical decision making meets the code level (e.g. Moderate Complexity for 99214) independent of procedure time and consent.

criteria.name: Exclusion: E/M Content Merely Duplicates Inherent Procedural Work
criteria.description: Disallow if the E/M documentation solely consists of procedure consent, site inspection, pre-procedure timeout, and post-procedure dressing/care instructions.
criteria.statutory_reference: OIG Report OEI-07-03-00470; National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI)
